fact: 1925年10月，为缓解佛罗里达铁路拥堵，各铁路公司对除食品外的货物实施禁运（embargo/moratorium），建筑材料运输被暂停；新买家不再进场，支撑土地热潮的价格上涨就此停止。这是佛罗里达1920年代土地泡沫由盛转衰的转折点，发生于1926年飓风之前。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Florida land boom of the 1920s
sources.quote: In October 1925, in an effort to improve Florida's clogged rail system, the railroad companies placed an embargo on all railway goods other than food, which further contributed to Florida's skyrocketing cost of living. New buyers failed to arrive, and the property price escalation that fueled the land boom stopped. The days of Miami properties being bought and sold at auction as many as ten times in one day were over. The first Florida real estate bubble had burst.

sources.title: NBER Working Paper w30914, Florida (Un)Chained
sources.quote: First, a railroad moratorium was placed on the shipping non-perishable goods in October 1925. The moratorium prevented building materials from reachingsouthern Florida except through steam ships, which were more expensive and slower.

fact: 1925年6月6日，沃尔特·克莱斯勒将麦克斯韦汽车公司（Maxwell Motor Company）改组为克莱斯勒公司（Chrysler Corporation），任总裁；新公司当年即录得超过400万美元净利润，到1925年底在美国拥有3800家经销商。

sources.title: Chrysler Historical Timeline（克莱斯勒百年官方时间线 PDF）
sources.quote: 1925 Maxwell Motors becomes Chrysler Corporation with Walter Chrysler as president on June 6, 1925. On June 6, the Maxwell Motor Company, whose shares are now worth $400 million, is transferred with all rights and obligations to the new Chrysler Corporation, which at the end of the year can already post a net profit of more than $4 million. ... At the end of the year, there are 3,800 Chrysler dealers in America.

sources.title: Chrysler Museum, Walter P. Chrysler, Jr: A Legacy
sources.quote: By 1925, he had founded his own car company, the Chrysler Corporation, and had brought out the first Chrysler automobile, establishing himself as one of the most innovative American industrialists of the first half of the twentieth century.

fact: 1925年底，AT&T旗下的WEAF连锁广播网已扩展到26家成员台，西至堪萨斯城；由广告主付费的连锁广播（chain broadcasting）成为独立产业。6月时该网还只有12家成员台，覆盖全国约42%人口。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Broadcasting Company of America
sources.quote: By the end of 1925 there were 26 affiliates in the standard WEAF chain network, extending westward to Kansas City, Missouri.

sources.title: Christopher H. Sterling, Dollars from the Ether: Early Broadcasting and Advertising（PCHARM）
sources.quote: As of June, 1925, what was called the WEAF Network consisted of 12 stations. ... Its coverage consisted of 42 percent of the nation's population. This demographic had 58 percent of incomes of more than $10,000 (presumably per household) and 48 percent of radio receivers (Banning 1946). Also by 1925, the money situation had begun to turn around: AT&T was realizing a $150,000 profit from its broadcasting venture (Barnouw, 1966).

fact: 1925年1月，福布斯已警告佛州土地价格「只建立在找到下家的预期上，而非任何土地价值现实」；10月起哈罗德·基茨的系列文章、巴伦周刊的评论加剧全国性负面报道，纽约的开发商在纽约开记者会反驳反而放大了悲观情绪。泡沫的心理面在1925年内已经反转。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Florida land boom of the 1920s
sources.quote: By January 1925, investors were beginning to read negative press about Florida investments. Forbes magazine warned that Florida land prices were based solely upon the expectation of finding a customer, not upon any reality of land value. New York bankers and the IRS both began to scrutinize the Florida real estate boom as a giant sham operation.

sources.title: NBER Working Paper w30914, Florida (Un)Chained
sources.quote: The boom peaked towards the end of 1925. No single event led to the crash. Instead, Florida real estate began to receive negative press throughout the rest of the nation starting in late 1925. For example, a series of syndicated articles by Harold Keats' during October 1925 highlighted how the boom in his view was reaching its end and anyone who was investing was only throwing their money away.

fact: 1925年美国生产的约300万辆汽车中约80%以延期付款（分期）售出；按均价800美元计，新车销售总额24亿美元，其中19.2亿为赊销合同，由此提供的信贷约12.8亿美元；加上二手车，1925年零售汽车信贷总额接近25亿美元，几乎全部由银行与折扣公司提供（银行与公司约4:1）。

sources.title: The Atlantic, The Land of Dignified Credit（1926年2月号，述1925年数据）
sources.quote: Eighty per cent of all automobiles manufactured in 1925 — approximately 3,000,000 — were sold on deferred payments. On the basis of an average price of $800, the sales of new cars totaled $2,400,000,000, of which the contract cars totaled $1,920,000,000, and the credit extended on them $1,280,000,000. ... Consequently the volume of credit extended in the field of retail automobile sales in 1925 was not far from $2,500,000,000. Practically all of it was extended by banks and discount companies, in the ratio of four bank dollars for one company dollar.

fact: 1925年美国耐用消费品的分期销售占比极高：按RCA销售管理人Melhuish的说法，当年留声机80%、汽车与洗衣机75%、吸尘器与家具约65%为分期售出；唯独收音机例外，约87%现金销售、仅13%分期（1926年分期需求大增）。这说明消费信贷已是主流，但不同商品的信贷渗透率差异很大。

sources.title: The New York Times, Instalment Plan Applied to Radio（1927-01-09，述1925—1926年数据）
sources.quote: Of the total sales in 1925 dealers sold for cash only 20 per cent. of all phonographs, only 25 per cent. of all automobiles and washing machines and only 35 per cent. of all vacuum cleaners and furniture. The remainder were all sold on instalments. This means that instalment sales represented 80 per cent. of phonograph sales, 75 per cent. of automobile and washing machine sales and approximately 65 per cent. of vacuum cleaner and furniture sales. During the same year practically 87 per cent. of all radio sets were sold for cash and only 13 per cent. on the instalment plan, according to H. T. Melhuish, manager of sales administration for the Radio Corporation of America.

fact: 1925年美国制造业平均周工资为24.60美元，纽约市为30.70美元；纽约州工厂工人1925年9月平均周收入28.32美元，接近1920年以来最高点，比1914年平均水平高123%。

sources.title: NBER Working Paper w18825, A Nation of Gamblers: Real Estate Speculation and American History
sources.quote: Average weekly manufacturing wages in the U.S. as a whole were $24.60 (~$324 in 2012 dollars) in 1925 and $30.70 (~$404 in 2012 dollars) in New York City.

sources.title: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Economic Policy Review（1925-11-01）
sources.quote: W age rates in the state generally remained little changed in September, but owing to slightly fuller work­ing time, average weekly earnings of factory workers in­creased slightly to $28.32, which was close to the highest level since 1920, and 123 per cent above the 1914 average.

fact: 1925年美国零售物价参考：西冷牛排41美分/磅、圆牛排36美分/磅、咖啡50美分/磅、一条面包近10美分、半加仑牛奶28美分、鸡蛋55美分/打、汽油约22美分/加仑、平信邮资2美分；1925年新车均价至少875美元。

sources.title: Tirekicking Today, A Century of Pay and Prices
sources.quote: The average new car in 1925 sold for at least $875. Gasoline prices peaked at an average 30 cents per gallon in 1920, but dropped to 22 cents in 1925. ... Sirloin steak doubled in price between 1910 and 1925, reaching 41 cents a pound. Round steak was 36 cents a pound in 1925, coffee 50 cents a pound, a loaf of bread nearly a dime. Milk sold for 28 cents a half-gallon; eggs 55 cents a dozen. Mailing a letter still cost just 2 cents.

fact: 1925年秋季纽约的公寓租金同比下降：1920年时月租每室15美元以上的公寓租金约降2%，低价公寓约降1%，高档公寓普遍给免租期优惠；但相对1914年，低价公寓租金仍高约90%，中价公寓高约60%。新建公寓大量入市是租金走软的直接原因。

sources.title: Federal Reserve Bank of New York, Economic Policy Review（1925-11-01，Apartment Rents）
sources.quote: Reports from representative apartment house owners and agents in the New York Metropolitan area indicate a decrease o f about 2 per cent from last year in rents of apartments which rented in 1920 for over $15 monthly per room and a reduction o f about 1 per cent in rents o f lower priced apartments. In addition to this slight down­ward tendency in quoted rents, the offering of concessions to prospective tenants is reported to be frequent, espec­ially in the higher priced apartments. Compared with 1914 levels, present rental rates fo r the cheaper apartments have advanced about 90 per cent

fact: 1925年7月11日晚，WEAF联播当晚节目全部由广告主冠名：Gimbel Brothers赞助的Lopez乐队、Happiness Candy赞助的Jones and Hare、National Carbon赞助的Ever-ready四重唱、Gold Dust Company赞助的Gold Dust Twins、Astor House Coffee赞助的舞会乐队。当时的赞助以节目冠名与间接宣传为主，直接叫卖式广告被限制。

sources.title: H. Banning / Burgess research materials, Impact of allocations（广播史档案汇编 PDF）
sources.quote: The evening of July 11, I925, affords an example of the use of the WEAF network by advertisers. The evening's broadcasting fare consisted of Vincent Lopez' orchestra sponsored by Gimbel Brothers, Jones and Hare sponsored by Happiness Candy, the Ever-ready Quartet sponsored by the National Carbon Company, the Gold Dust Twins sponsored by the Gold Dust Company, and the Fisher Astor Coffee dance orchestra sponsored by Astor House Coffee.

sources.title: The Radio Historian, The Beginnings of Radio Broadcasting Networks
sources.quote: These programs were sold as "goodwill" promotions for their sponsors, and direct-sale announcements were prohibited. The sponsor's benefits were limited to program naming rights and indirect promotional announcements in the openings and closings of the programs.

fact: 克莱斯勒公司1925年成为美国第一家引入曲轴减振器（crankshaft vibration damper）的汽车制造商；1924年推出的Chrysler Six（售价1565美元）以高压缩六缸发动机和乘用车首次标配的四轮液压制动为卖点。汽车工业的「工程卖点」营销在1925年前后成型。

sources.title: Chrysler Historical Timeline（克莱斯勒百年官方时间线 PDF）
sources.quote: Chrysler is the first U.S. automaker to introduce crankshaft vibration dampers. ... 1924: In 1924, Chrysler introduced the Chrysler Six, an all-new vehicle priced at $1,565 that featured two significant innovations—a light, powerful, high-compression six-cylinder engine and the first four-wheel hydraulic brakes to come standard on a passenger car.

fact: 1925年佛州土地以「期权转手」（binder）方式炒作：买家以30天或更短的付款期权锁定地块，拿到权属凭证后立刻加价转卖（所谓Binder Boys），同一地块一天内可被转手多次；大量地块通过邮购、看图纸成交，买家从未实地看地。纽约的银行家与美国国税局（IRS）在1925年已开始把佛州地产繁荣当作大型骗局（sham）审查。

sources.title: Wikibooks, History of Florida/Modern Florida, 1900-1945
sources.quote: People called Binder Boys also invested in buying the land to become rich quick by selling these lots as quick as they bought it. Binder Boys precipitated the peak of the land boom by buying the options of land parcels that had a payment due in thirty days or less, which was more than the cost itself. After buying the land parcels, they would get an ownership document and flip the document for a higher price.

sources.title: Wikipedia, Florida land boom of the 1920s
sources.quote: New York bankers and the IRS both began to scrutinize the Florida real estate boom as a giant sham operation. Speculators intent on flipping properties at huge profits began to have a difficult time finding new buyers.

fact: 1925年前后的美国零售信贷由银行与「折扣公司」（discount companies）提供，汽车信贷中银行与公司出资约4:1；制造商也通过附属折扣公司进入信贷领域。分期合同（instalment contract）是当时合法的主流交易形式，但对逾期与收回的执行细节各州不同。

sources.title: The Atlantic, The Land of Dignified Credit（1926年2月号）
sources.quote: Practically all of it was extended by banks and discount companies, in the ratio of four bank dollars for one company dollar. ... The fact that automobile credit is being cheapened by manufacturers entering the credit field, through subsidiary discount companies, may hide for some time to come the tendency to periodicity inherent in the invasion of future earnings on twelve months' paper

fact: 佛州地产热潮带动大规模销售队伍：仅Coral Gables一个项目就以300万美元广告预算、3000名销售员在全国推销，还请来威廉·詹宁斯·布莱恩站台；迈阿密港区吞吐能力不足，1925年秋已有船只在港外排队等泊位，运费与建材价格被进一步推高。

sources.title: Wikibooks, History of Florida/Modern Florida, 1900-1945
sources.quote: George Merrick's planned community of Coral Gables is a prime example of this. With a $3 million advertisement budget and 3,000 salesmen across the country, as well as William Jennings Bryan to extoll Coral Gables, it easily gained buyers across the country. ... The Port of Miami had several ships sit outside of the harbour because of a lack of docks or workers stalled port activities.

fact: WEAF广播网的广告商业模式在1925—1926年被市场验证：1926年5月11日AT&T把广播业务并入Broadcasting Company of America，7月以100万美元把WEAF及其联播网卖给RCA，随后RCA、通用电气、西屋共同组建NBC；1926年11月15日NBC红网以25家成员台开播。1925年每小时全网晚间时段标准价约4080美元，旗舰WEAF单台每小时480美元。

sources.title: Wikipedia, Broadcasting Company of America
sources.quote: The standard charge for an hour of evening programming over the entire roster of stations was $4,080, before any applicable discounts. ... the sale of BCA's assets, principally WEAF and its associated chain operations, to RCA for $1 million. ... AT&T sold WEAF and its Red Network to RCA for $1 million

sources.title: The Radio Historian, The Beginnings of Radio Broadcasting Networks
sources.quote: The WEAF Network was reorganized as the NBC Red Network, with its inaugural broadcast over 25 stations occurring on November 15, 1926.
